accessibleSummaries.behavior: Position contains 1,200 derivative samples at 0.10-second intervals with coordinates in meters.
accessibleSummaries.comparison: Model scores use the same held-out target, chronological split, and mean Poisson deviance definition; lower is better.
accessibleSummaries.correlation: The cross-correlogram counts event-pair lags for synthetic-unit-01 and synthetic-unit-02 within plus or minus 0.25 seconds; it does not establish connectivity.
accessibleSummaries.embedding: The two-dimensional unit feature map uses standardized mean firing rate and inter-spike-interval variability; distance is descriptive.
accessibleSummaries.heatmap: The rate heatmap contains 4 unit rows and 1,200 fixed 0.1-second bins.
accessibleSummaries.isi: The inter-spike interval histogram describes synthetic-unit-01 between zero and two seconds.
accessibleSummaries.prediction: Held-out observed and predicted next-bin counts are shown only for a fitted, checksummed model artifact.
accessibleSummaries.provenance: This is deterministic synthetic data, not a biological recording.
accessibleSummaries.raster: 4 sorted units contribute 776 spikes over 120 seconds; the across-unit mean rate is 1.62 spikes per second per unit.
accessibleSummaries.residual: Residuals are observed minus predicted held-out 100-millisecond spike counts.
accessibleSummaries.tuning: The speed-tuning table uses synthetic-unit-01 and includes occupancy seconds beside every firing-rate bin.

derived.crossDisclosure: Counts are event-pair lags within ±0.25 seconds; they do not establish connectivity or causality.

embedding.method: Descriptive feature map: x is z-scored mean firing rate and y is z-scored inter-spike-interval coefficient of variation. This is not a learned low-dimensional embedding.

derived.isiRangeDisclosure: Only inter-spike intervals from 0 to 2 seconds are counted.

tuning.upperEdgeRule: 99th-percentile speed; larger values are clamped to the final bin

metadata.attribution: Generated locally from the recorded seed; no biological source.
metadata.disclosure: Deterministic generated fixture used only when the public derivative is unavailable or for tests. It is not a biological recording and must not support scientific-performance claims.
metadata.license: No external dataset license; generated project fixture
